name: get_products_by_gtins
description: Looks up one product by its GTIN (barcode/EAN) on Carrefour France through the site search (GET /s?q=<GTIN>, JSON). Returns the matching product with EAN, title, brand, slug, categories, images, business type, offerServiceId and offers. One GTIN per call: several GTINs in one query turn into a text search and return unrelated products.

gtin.description: The GTIN (EAN/barcode string) identifying the product to retrieve.
